title: Apple Just Killed Siri and Nobody Noticed
angle: Apple quietly buried Siri by outsourcing its brain to ChatGPT — making their own AI irrelevant before it ever got smart.

scenes.voiceover: Apple spent 13 years building Siri. Then quietly handed her brain to their biggest competitor.
scenes.visual_description: Black screen. Bold white text slams in: 'SIRI IS DEAD.' Red X graphic pulses over Siri logo. Hard cut to Apple logo cracking.
scenes.caption_overlay: They didn't announce it. They just… did it.

scenes.scene_name: The Evidence — What Apple Actually Did
scenes.voiceover: iOS 18.1. Ask Siri anything hard — she literally hands you off to ChatGPT. That's not an assistant. That's a redirect.
scenes.visual_description: Phone screen shows Siri prompt. User asks complex question. Siri UI fades and ChatGPT interface slides in. Arrow graphic: 'YOUR DATA → OPENAI.'
scenes.caption_overlay: Siri can't answer. So she sends you to the competition.

scenes.voiceover: Apple acquired Siri in 2010. Promised she'd get smarter every year. Fourteen years later — she outsources to ChatGPT.
scenes.visual_description: Fast cuts: 2011 Siri launch keynote clip, Steve Jobs silhouette, year counter spinning 2011→2024, then OpenAI logo fills screen with a THUD.
scenes.caption_overlay: 14 years. Billions spent. Still not good enough.

scenes.scene_name: The Bigger Problem — Apple's AI Crisis
scenes.voiceover: Google has Gemini built in. Samsung has Galaxy AI. Apple's answer? Borrow someone else's. That is a five-alarm crisis.
scenes.visual_description: Split screen: Google Gemini logo, Samsung AI logo, then Apple logo alone with a question mark. Text explodes: 'WHERE IS APPLE'S AI?' Camera shake effect.
scenes.caption_overlay: Every competitor built their own. Apple borrowed.

scenes.scene_name: The Twist — This Was the Plan All Along
scenes.voiceover: Or… this is exactly what Apple wants. Let OpenAI absorb the liability. Keep your hands clean. Classic Apple.
scenes.visual_description: Tight face shot of speaker. Eyebrow raise. Slow smirk. Text bubble pops in: 'Wait… is Apple actually the smart one here?' Zoom punch on face.
scenes.caption_overlay: What if killing Siri was genius?

scenes.scene_name: The Loop — Back to the Grave
scenes.voiceover: Either way — the Siri you knew is gone. The only question is whether Apple knows what comes next. Do they?
scenes.visual_description: Screen returns to opening: 'SIRI IS DEAD.' text. Then slow fade to: 'Or was she ever really alive?' Loop-cut back to frame one.
scenes.caption_overlay: Go back to the start. Watch it again.

hook_test.format_reference: The Real Reason X Happened — hidden explanation with conspiracy-adjacent reveal
hook_test.viral_proof: Videos using 'Apple killed X and nobody noticed' framing consistently hit 10M-40M views on TikTok. Reference: MrMobile and iJustine reaction formats on Apple AI news, plus creator @technewssimplified hitting 18M views on 'Apple Intelligence is a lie' format in Oct 2024.
hook_test.why_it_works: The phrase 'nobody noticed' triggers FOMO and insider knowledge bias — viewers feel they are getting a secret. Combined with Apple brand recognition and AI anxiety, this hits three viral triggers: identity threat, institutional betrayal, and fear of missing out.
